{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the presence of 'refunded' orders
print("Status values and counts:\n", sales['status'].value_counts())

# Check the revenue column type and sample values
print("\nRevenue sample (first 5):\n", sales['revenue'].head(5))

# Check for the QA orders with 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"\nNumber of QA orders (revenue == '999999.99'): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print(f"\nNumber of -1 in customer_age: {sales[sales['customer_age'] == -1].shape[0]}")"}
